transcript: My name is Nethmi Silva and I am a recent computing graduate preparing for a UI slash UX designer role. My background includes hands-on work with Figma, wire-framing, and usability testing, mainly through academic projects, individual practice, and collaborative assignments. One area I enjoy most is creating simple and user-friendly digital experiences. For example, I contributed to a job portal prototype in the recruitment domain, where I learned how to plan tasks, communicate with teammates, and deliver features with clear ownership. I am applying for this role because I want to strengthen my technical foundation in a real production environment and grow into a professional who combines problem-solving with consistent execution. At the same time, I am actively working on explaining technical ideas more briefly so I can present my ideas more effectively in professional discussions. A project I am proud of is the job portal prototype, which was created for the recruitment domain. I worked in a team of two and my main contribution was to create profile matching logic and improved search filters. We used Figma, wire-framing, and usability testing to build and validate the solution. One of the main challenges was irrelevant job results. To address it, I broke the issue into smaller parts, discussed possible solutions with the team, and tested the final approach before completing the integration. The project was valuable because it improved my technical understanding and taught me how to communicate progress clearly under deadlines. As a result, the final system improved role matching quality for users.
